A below position pays if o1 lists cheaply, and it also pays if o1 never launches, because every rung then resolves NO. The link is weak on timing, because this market covers only May 2026 and GRVT's launch date is unknown. I hold it as a small directional expression of the risk-off world, not a tight one.
